remarks: Three bedroom 1.5 bath duplex in Glenbrook. Hardwood flooring in living room, kitchen, bedrooms and hallway. New recessed lighting in living room. New sliding glass doors from kitchen eating area to new trex deck with staircase and railings. Renovated kitchen with all new custom cabinets, quartz countertops. Stainless steel appliances. Half bath on main level. Upstairs are three bedrooms and full bath. One wall air conditioner on each level. Full size washer and dryer in basement. Tenant has use of right side of garage for storage and one parking space on right side of driveway. Ample street parking. No dogs, no satellite dish and no smoking allowed on premises. Good credit a MUST.

facts.laundryLoc: Lower level, washer & dryer on rt side
